zh.title: 俄羅斯無人機襲擊致莫斯科四大機場暫停運作
zh.summary: 四機場關閉；阿聯酋A380滯留彭澤；防空擊落九架無人機
body: 10月23日下午，莫斯科四大機場——謝列梅捷沃（SVO）、多莫傑多沃（DME）、伏努科沃（VKO）和朱科夫斯基（ZIA）——因俄羅斯防空攔截逼近首都的無人機，全部停止起降。
Rosaviatsiya於14:05以飛行安全限制四機場；伏努科沃、多莫傑多沃改許可制並於16:43恢復，謝列梅捷沃、朱科夫斯基仍關閉。阿聯酋航空EK133（空中巴士A380）從杜拜飛往多莫傑多沃，Flightradar24顯示其在彭澤地區盤旋待許可。
市長索比亞寧稱防空於13:39前擊落九架無人機並持續攔截，但說法未經獨立驗證。

en.title: Drone attacks shut all four Moscow airports for second time in two days
en.summary: Four Moscow airports closed; Emirates A380 circles Penza; air defenses down nine drones
body: On the afternoon of 23 October 2026, all four Moscow airports — Sheremetyevo (SVO), Domodedovo (DME), Vnukovo (VKO) and Zhukovsky (ZIA) — halted arrivals and departures after Russian air defences engaged drones approaching the capital.

Rosaviatsiya issued a notice at 14:05 Moscow time (11:05 UTC) citing flight safety; Vnukovo and Domodedovo were limited to operations with explicit clearance from 12:55 and 13:00 respectively and resumed under that regime at 16:43, while Sheremetyevo and Zhukovsky remained closed. Emirates flight EK133, operated by an Airbus A380 from Dubai to Domodedovo, was observed by Flightradar24 circling over the Penza region while awaiting clearance.

Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin reported that air defences had destroyed nine drones by 13:39 and reported further interceptions after the closures, though the claims have not been independently verified.

sources.name: AeroTime — Drone attacks shut all four Moscow airports for second time…

facts.claim: All four Moscow airports stopped accepting and dispatching aircraft on the afternoon of 23 October 2026 due to drone attacks.
facts.sourceQuote: All four airports serving Moscow stopped accepting and dispatching aircraft on the afternoon of October 23, 2026, as Russian air defenses engaged drones approaching the capital.

facts.claim: Rosaviatsiya announced restrictions at Sheremetyevo (SVO), Domodedovo (DME), Vnukovo (VKO) and Zhukovsky (ZIA) at 14:05 Moscow time (11:05 UTC) citing flight safety.
facts.sourceQuote: Russia’s Federal Air Transport Agency (Rosaviatsiya) announced the restrictions at Sheremetyevo (SVO), Domodedovo (DME), Vnukovo (VKO), and Zhukovsky (ZIA) in a notice published at 14:05 Moscow time (11:05 UTC), citing flight safety.

facts.claim: Vnukovo and Domodedovo resumed accepting and dispatching flights under clearance at 16:43 Moscow time, while Sheremetyevo and Zhukovsky remained closed.
facts.sourceQuote: At 16:43 Moscow time, Rosaviatsiya said that Vnukovo and Domodedovo had resumed accepting and dispatching flights under that clearance regime, after the restrictions were adjusted. As of that notice, the agency had announced no change at Sheremetyevo or Zhukovsky.

facts.claim: The disruption affected an Emirates Airbus A380 operating flight EK133 from Dubai to Moscow Domodedovo.
facts.sourceQuote: The disruption also affected an Emirates Airbus A380 operating flight EK133 from Dubai to Moscow Domodedovo.

facts.claim: Flightradar24 showed the double-deck aircraft circling over Russia’s Penza region while awaiting clearance.
facts.sourceQuote: Flight-tracking data from Flightradar24 showed the double-deck aircraft circling over Russia’s Penza region, southeast of Moscow, while awaiting clearance to continue toward its destination.

facts.claim: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin reported that air defences destroyed nine drones by 13:39 Moscow time and reported further interceptions after the airport closures; the claims were not independently verified.
facts.sourceQuote: By 13:39 Moscow time, before the full closure, Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin had reported that air defenses had destroyed nine drones flying toward the city and that emergency services were working where debris had fallen, according to the city government . He reported further interceptions after the airports were closed. The claims could not be independently verified.
